questions.prompt: Two trains travel on parallel tracks in the same direction at 60 km/h and 40 km/h. What is the speed of the faster train as observed from the slower one?
questions.explanation: Relative velocity in 1D (same direction) = v₁ - v₂ = 60 - 40 = 20 km/h. The faster train appears to move at 20 km/h relative to the slower one.

questions.prompt: A boat moves at 5 m/s in still water. It heads directly across a river flowing at 3 m/s. What is the boat's speed relative to the ground?
questions.explanation: The two velocities are perpendicular: boat at 5 m/s across, river at 3 m/s downstream. Magnitude of resultant = sqrt(5² + 3²) = sqrt(34) ≈ 5.83 m/s.

questions.prompt: Person A walks east at 1 m/s; person B walks west at 2 m/s. The velocity of B relative to A is:
questions.explanation: Take east as positive. v_A = +1 m/s, v_B = -2 m/s. v_(B relative to A) = v_B - v_A = -2 - 1 = -3 m/s, i.e. 3 m/s west.
